actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent RNA-defined biological identity with large, FDR-significant pathway effect sizes (immune activation, metabolic suppression) and supportive BAP1 mutation enrichment and CNV changes. Technical confounders are not significant, and known-label overlap is minimal. Although cross-modal silhouettes are weak, RNA provides a strong and coherent signal, and structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge. Retaining C0001 for downstream validation is better supported than Drop.

C0002 shows a reciprocal, coherent RNA-defined biological identity (immune suppression, metabolic activation) with large effect sizes, significant BAP1 depletion, and mirror-image CNV changes. Technical confounders are not significant, and known-label overlap is minimal. Despite weak cross-modal silhouettes, RNA provides a strong and coherent signal, and structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge. Retaining C0002 for downstream validation is better supported than Drop.
